items.summary: Recommend approving containment and rejecting all new spend, budget commitments, revenue forecasts, ROI claims, margin claims, monetization expansion, and new delivery admissions this cycle. Evidence: Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21 with 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; all $4.92 is in an aggregate provider row, so site-attributed revenue is $0 and site-level revenue claims are unsupported. September 2026 AI usage was $1,002.46 across 5,531 calls, with 234 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin is not calculable because revenue and AI-cost windows do not match and infrastructure, domain, labor, and other operating costs are absent. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because no per-change cost allocation, validated financial outcome, or treatment/control value delta is available. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 57 improvements measuring and 21 implementation requests failed. Retain only existing capacity-gated work and the CFO report-only reconciliation below; do not claim forecasted revenue from opportunity scores or vanity metrics.

Do not admit the proposed driveford.net preview, new product work, new experiments, or monetization changes while delivery remains at 10/10 active slots and financial attribution is incomplete. Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z with the required validation, rollback, attribution, measurement, and deduplication evidence. Any subsequent implementation must preserve existing tracking IDs and produce a measurable registered-affiliate-click or other site-level outcome; no revenue, margin, ROI, or causal-lift claim is authorized without matched-period evidence.

Use matched reporting windows before approving financial claims: per-site and per-change AI cost, infrastructure/domain/hosting cost, registered affiliate clicks, ordered items, shipped items, commission, and treatment-versus-control outcome deltas. The current $4.92 aggregate commission must remain unattributed. The 84 site-factory opportunity score and traffic, impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, and social-account counts are not revenue forecasts or contribution-margin evidence.
